newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac says 1st half profit better.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac says 1st half profit better.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Thursday that its profit for the six months to March 31 was better than a year ago.
When asked at a news conference if profits for its first half were better than a year ago, Westpac chief executive Bob Joss said: "Yes, better than a year ago."
Westpac reported a net profit of A$565 million for the six months to March 31, 1996, up from A$480 million a year ago.
Joss said he was generally pleased with the bank's ongoing in 1996/97 performance. "We're happy now with the way things are going this year," Joss said.
Earlier on Thursday, Westpac announced an agreed A$1.435 billion merger with regional Bank of Melbourne Ltd.
The merger is subject to government approval.
